text_block_list.text:
One day, we learn that Нарита Брайан has
suffered
an injury. During our visit to the
hospital, Hishi
Amazon announces that
she'll be waiting for her
at the Arima
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After some time, Нарита Брайан is
discharged. She
asks Хиши Амадзон why
she's so fixated on her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон replies that something
about Brian
makes her want to catch up
to her—to overtake
her—no matter how
far away she gets.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан looks satisfied by the
response. It
turns out that she, too, has
someone she wants to
overtake.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
